errors.text_span: БВП на човек (в ППС) на човек
errors.evidence: The phrase '...per capita (in PPS) per capita' is redundant and poorly constructed.

errors.text_span: с начална стойност 30,5 и крайна стойност 83,2
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly identifies data points from the plot (starting and ending X-values for Estonia) as the range of the X-axis. The actual X-axis range is from 20 to 90.
The description omits the crucial part of the axis labels, 'ЕС28=100', which explains that the values are an index relative to the EU28 average.

errors.text_span: с начална стойност 28,2 и крайна стойност 79,6
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly identifies data points from the plot (starting Y-value for Lithuania and ending Y-value for Estonia) as the range of the Y-axis. The actual Y-axis range is from 20 to 90.
The description states the Y-axis has intervals of 5 points, but the grid lines and tick labels clearly show intervals of 10.

errors.text_span: На синя линия се визуализира БВП на човек (в ППС) за Естония.
errors.evidence: This is a fundamental misinterpretation of the plot. The blue line represents the relationship between two variables (GDP per capita on the X-axis and HICP on the Y-axis) for Estonia, not just one variable.

errors.text_span: който достига своя връх около стойност 72,3
errors.evidence: The description claims the blue line (Estonia) peaks at a Y-value of 72.3. The final and peak Y-value for Estonia is 79.6. The value 72.3 is the final Y-value for Latvia (orange line).

errors.text_span: На оранжев път са изобразени стойностите на ИЦН за Латвия.
errors.evidence: This is a fundamental misinterpretation of the plot. The orange line represents the relationship between two variables (GDP per capita on the X-axis and HICP on the Y-axis) for Latvia, not just one variable.

errors.text_span: Пътят започва на стойност 61,6 и достига 81,6.
errors.evidence: The start and end values for Latvia's path are incorrect. Latvia's X-values range from approximately 31 to 68.9. The value 81.6 is the final X-value for Lithuania (gray line).

errors.text_span: На сива линия са представени стойностите на ИЦН за Литва.
errors.evidence: This is a fundamental misinterpretation of the plot. The gray line represents the relationship between two variables (GDP per capita on the X-axis and HICP on the Y-axis) for Lithuania, not just one variable.

errors.text_span: Линията започва на стойност 66,5 и достига стойност 79,6.
errors.evidence: The start and end values for Lithuania's path are incorrect. 66.5 is the final Y-value for Lithuania, not the start. 79.6 is the final Y-value for Estonia (blue line).

errors.text_span: който достига своя връх около стойност 83,2
errors.evidence: The description claims the gray line (Lithuania) peaks at a value of 83.2. The peak Y-value for Lithuania is 66.5. The value 83.2 is the final X-value for Estonia (blue line).
The description completely omits the black diagonal line, which is a key reference feature on the plot representing where the X and Y values are equal.
